## Agarican, Bolite (CR 1/2)

**XP** 200  
Bolite warrior 1  
LN Small plant (fungus)  
**Init** +3; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +4  


**Defense**


**AC** 17, touch 15, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 size, +2 armor)  
**hp** 7 (1d10+1)  
**Fort** +3, **Ref** +3, **Will** +1  
**Immune** plant traits, mutable  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** spear +4 (1d6+3 plus poison)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 15, **Dex** 16, **Con** 13, **Int** 12, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 6  
**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +2, **CMD** 15  
**Feats** Dodge  
**Skills** Climb +6, Perception +5, Profession (herbalist) +5  
**Languages** Agaric, Common  


**Special Abilities**


**Luminescent Lamella (Ex)** The underside of a bolite’s cap emits a soft, steady glow with light equivalent to a candle.  

**Poison (Ex)** A number of times per day equal to their Constitution modifier (minimum 1/day) a bolite can coat a weapon they wield with sticky, toxic spores. Applying poison this way is a swift action.
